title: Bringing Back Kay-Kay
author: Dev Kothari
tags: Around the world, Poetry and rhyme
description: When Lena’s older brother goes missing, she knows she must find him. But what secrets will she uncover? A gripping mystery set in contemporary India, with themes of family expectations and the importance of the arts.

title: Hercules: The Diary of a (Sort Of) Hero
author: Tom Vaughan, illustrated David O’Connell
tags: Adventure, Chapter books, Funny, Myths and legends
description: Hercules’ plan to play it cool when he starts secondary school goes awry when he becomes a target for the school bully. With the arrival of his estranged Greek father, Hercules’ popularity surges, but at what cost? With a generous smattering of Greek mythology, this laugh-out-loud tale explores the nature of friendship, love and loyalty with a perfect mix of warmth and humour.

title: I Am Wolf
author: Alastair Chisholm
description: Apacy dystopian page-turner.

title: Impossible Creatures
author: Katherine Rundell, illustrated Tomislav Tomic
description: Katherine Rundell has created an incredibly real-feeling magical world and story to rival classics like Narnia, with writing that sweeps you up and main characters who are simultaneously humanly flawed yet inherently pure and good.

title: Lunar
author: Chris Bradford, illustrated Charlotte Grange
description: With a great mix of science fiction and science fact, this nail-biting race-against-time is presented in an accessible format with black and white illustrations.

title: Safiyyah’s War
author: Hiba Noor Khan
tags: Around the world, Coming-of-age, Historical, Thriller
description: Focussing on the experiences of a small group of individuals, Safiyyah’s story shines a spotlight on an under-recognised pocket of resistance from World War II when hundreds of Jews were led to safety via underground passages from the Grand Mosque in Paris.

title: Geoffrey Gets the Jitters
author: Nadia Shireen
description: Geoffrey’s jitters are out of control! How can he get rid of them? Told with humour and great empathy, this picture book from the author-illustrator ofBarbara Throws a Wobbleris both funny and helpful.

title: Big Bad Dragon Club
author: by Beach
tags: Funny, Picture books, Poetry and rhyme
description: A funny picture book about dragons learning they don’t always have to be bad!

title: Green: The Story of Plant Life on Our Planet
author: Nicola Davies, illustrated Emily Sutton
description: A beautifully illustrated book explaining how plants evolved and how they work now.

title: Femi and the Mindfulness Machine
author: Flo Fielding, illustrated Sawyer Cloud
description: Femi’s wind machine for Science Daydoesn’talways work. Gran has some useful advice – but what will happen at school when it matters? With techniques to calm anxiety, and gorgeous illustrations, this picture book will stimulate conversations about feelings.

title: Gina Kaminski Saves the Wolf
author: Craig Barr-Green, illustrated Francis Martin
tags: Adventure, Picture books, Autistic spectrum conditions, Neurodiversity
description: Retelling of Little Red Riding Hood with a neurodivergent protagonist.

title: I’m Going to be a Princess
author: Stephanie Taylor, illustrated Jade Orlando
description: On her way home from school, Maya announces that she wants to be a princess when she grows up. Mum encourages her to consider other professions, but Maya won’t change her mind. Though maybe it’s not a fairy tale princess she’s thinking about. A witty story about inspirational black women.

title: One Little Word
author: Joseph Coelho, illustrated Allison Colpoys
description: This is a poignant picture book about the power of friendship and knowing when to say sorry. The gentle, lyrical text from Children’s Laureate Joseph Coelho handles the familiar heightened emotions of playground-fall outs in a way that feels sincere and authentic.

title: Snail in Space
author: Rachel Bright, illustrated Nadia Shireen
tags: Funny, Picture books, Poetry and rhyme
description: Gail is a little snail with a big dream – to become the first snail in space! A hilarious story about the power of passion and persistence.

title: The Concrete Garden
author: Bob Graham
description: Children join in to draw a beautiful garden with chalk. A gorgeous picture book celebratingcommunityand the positive effect art has oneveryone.

title: The Egg Incident
author: Ziggy Hanaor, illustrated Daisy Wynter
description: Humphrey the eggisn’tallowed to do anything energetic – especially not climb walls. But when he and his new friend are locked in the park, hehas toescape somehow! A very funny graphic novel that will have children gigglingout loud.

title: The Thunk
author: Michelle Robinson, illustrated Deborah Allwright
tags: Funny, Picture books, Poetry and rhyme
description: This is a fabulously funny picture book by the author ofTen Fat Sausages,brimming full of Michelle Robinson’s trademark silly humour.

title: This Rock is Mine
author: illustrated Alice McKinley
description: This is a fabulously funny picture book by the author of Ten Fat Sausages brimming full of Michelle Robinson’s trademark silly humour. So The Thunk is a beast, a bit like a skink, although more like a skunk on account of the stink, thought to be extinct but young explorer Hector Voltaire who’s had his fair share of other kids saying his head’s full of air, is determined to find one.

title: We Went to Find a Woolly Mammoth
author: Catherine Cawthorne, illustrated Aysha Awwad
description: Join the children as they search for a woolly mammoth and discover lots of other giant Ice Age animals along the way! Charming and informative, with very cute illustrations.

title: Who’s Afraid of the Light?
author: Anna McGregor
description: Meet Fergus, who is a real deep-sea creature. But we can only see his eyes. What could he be? An enjoyable anarchic mash-up of fiction and non-fiction, with facts at the end, and a surprise reveal.

title: The Breakfast Club Adventures: The Phantom Thief
author: Marcus Rashford and Alex Falase-Koya, illustrated Marta Kissi
description: Can the Breakfast Club Investigators find the Phantom Thief and save Asim from being blamed? A gentle mystery with short chapters and lots of energetic illustrations.

title: The Council of Good Friends
author: Nikesh Shukla, illustrated Rochelle Falconer
description: Vinay and his​“Council of Friends” aredisrupted by the arrival of his cousin. Together, they learn toset aside their differences and empathise with each other’s feelings.

title: A First Book of Dinosaurs
author: Simon Mole, illustrated Matt Hunt
description: This fun and inventive collection of thirty roar-some, illustrated poems celebrates the weird and wonderful world of dinosaurs.

title: A World of Dogs
author: Carlie Sorosiak, illustrated Luisa Uribe
description: A fascinating non-fiction bookthat detailseverything on dogs!

title: Carrie and the Roller Boots
author: Lisa Thompson, illustrated Jess Rose
description: Carrie devises an elaborate roller-skating routine to perform at her school assembly, but she’s never roller-skated before and it’s much trickier than she thought. This delightful, illustrated chapter book about friendship and perseverance is ideal for dyslexic or reluctant readers.

title: Huxley and Flapjack Race to the Rescue
author: Alan Macdonald, illustrated Francesca Gambatesa
description: Meet Huxley the irrepressible koala and Flapjack the cautious penguin. Together, they have lots of adventures, but can they catch a thief? A fun chapter book packed with energy and brilliant colour illustrations.

title: Keisha Jones Takes on the World
author: Natalie Denny, illustrated Chanté Timothy
description: Keisha wants to be like her inspiring Great Aunt Bee and stand up for what’s right. Her first cause is the price of bunnies in the pet shop. Funny and packed with brilliant illustrations, this will have young readers coming back for more in the series.

title: Max & Chaffy: Welcome to Animal Island
author: Jamie Smart
description: Max has just moved to Animal Island where there are lots of new friends – including a chaffy. But Chaffy is lost! Can you help Max find Chaffy? This very young, colourful graphic novel series is brilliantly interactive and full of fun.

title: Meet the Maliks, Twin Detectives The Cookie Culprit
author: Zanib Mian, illustrated Kyan Cheng
description: Can Maysa and Musa solve the mystery of who destroyed the competition cookies? Relatable and funny, this is a story about everyday family life, with a gentle mystery and a BIG lie at the heart of it.

title: My Family Your Family
author: Laura Henry-Allain, illustrated Giovana Medeiros
description: An accessible, usefulnon-fictionguide to all types of families.

title: Our Earth is a Poem: poetry about nature
author: By various, illustrated Annalise Barber, Mariana Roldan, Masha Manapov and Nabila Adani
description: A stunning collection of poems, beautifully illustrated, that explores and celebrate nature in its various magnificent forms. Perfect for reading aloud, and for curling up with.

title: Pablo and Splash
author: Sheena Dempsey
description: Pablo and Splash are two penguins who’veaccidentallytime-travelled to the Cretaceous period! Can they get home to the icy Antarctic beforethey’reeaten by dinosaurs?A funny colour graphic novel for newly confident readers.

title: Space Pirate Bears
author: Alastair Chisholm, illustrated Jez Tuya
description: A funny and inventive picture book that celebrates the power of storytelling. One dreary day Dad tells Jamie and Abby a story about a band of intergalactic heroes – the Space Pirate Bears – who must defeat evil Doktor Drab and save the galaxy from dullness…

title: Spyceratops
author: Alex Willmore
description: Spy goggles? Check. Spy bike? Check. Get ready for a top-secret action-packed Spyceratops mission. Super fun – with a surprise ending.

title: The Ghost Cat Who Saved my Life
author: Pamela Butchart, illustrated Monika Filipina
description: When Sav and Liam hear a cat meowing in the upstairs flat, they decide it must be a ghost, so go to investigate. An engaging, heart-warming mystery, ideal for reluctant and dyslexic readers.

title: The Girl Who Became a Fish
author: Polly Ho-Yen, illustrated Sojung Kim-McCarthy
description: Despite being terrified of water, Ita feels strangely drawn to the nearby river and, when she ventures to put her hands beneath the surface, discovers something unexpected and magical that gradually changes how she sees the world.

title: Tiny the Secret Adventurer
author: Aisha Bushby, illustrated Kübra Teber
description: Tiny is a miniature girl who lives among the petals of a sunflower. She embarks on a big adventure when she goes in search of friendship. This gentle, inclusive tale explores the effects of bullying and demonstrates the importance of tolerance and kindness.

title: We Are All Astronauts!
author: Kate Pankhurst
description: Luna and her granny learn how to be astronauts together. Packed with space facts, and brilliantly illustrated, this is inspiring STEM content for any child.

title: Yomi and the Fury of Ninki Nanka
author: Davina Tijani, illustrated Adam Douglas-Bagley
description: Yomi, aged around 10 and her younger brother Kay are spending the summer with their Uncle Olu who is a Nkara (dragon) researcher travelling the world lecturing on African studies. They are in The Gambia’s capital city Banjul when Yomi sees Ninki Nanka, the famous and ferocious water dragon and realises it is in trouble.

title: Best Friends Forever
author: Lisa Williamson
description: This funny and touching coming-of-age story reflects the experiences of many youngsters making the transition to secondary school or experiencing changes in the family.

title: Bright Stars of Black British History
author: illustrated Angela Vives
description: Engagingly told life stories of fourteen Black British people and their contributions to the world.

title: Calling the Whales
author: Jasbinder Bilan, illustrated Skylar White
description: Apowerful and quick to read adventure storyon saving a humpback whalein Scotland.

title: Monster in the Woods
author: Dave Shelton
description: A brilliantly funny, and gloriously rambling, historical hunt for a monster with a great twist at the end and a subtle message about not judging by appearances.

title: Oh Maya Gods
author: Maz Evans
description: Super-sporty Vesper and super-bright Aster are cousins and now reluctant partners in stopping Kizin, the Maya god of death, from killing everyone in the world. A brilliant adventure full of action and humour… and chocolate!

title: Scrap
author: Guy Bass, illustrated Alessia Trunfio
description: Scrap the robot has vowed never to help another human. Now two children need him, and he’s catapulted into a breakneck adventure full of action and humour. A fantastic read.

title: Shiver Point
author: Gabriel Dylan
description: A short, snappy rollercoaster of a horror story with a skilful build-up of tension from​‘This sleepy town is so bland, nothing ever happens here’ to​‘Aargh, we’re all going to die!’.

title: Size Wise
author: Camilla de la Bedoyere, illustrated Vasilisa Romanenko
description: From the big to the small, size is important and can tell us a lot about the animals and plants that live on planet Earth. This fascinating book zooms in on size to reveal all kinds of interesting facts about why things are the size that they are, and to give young readers a sense of scale.

title: Stolen History
author: Sathnam Sanghera, illustrated Jen Khatun
description: An accessible and fascinating look at the British Empire and how it still affects our lives today.

title: The Beasts of Knobbly Bottom: Attack of the Vampire Sheep
author: Emily-Jane Clark, illustrated Jeff Crowther
tags: Adventure, Chapter books, Fantasy, Funny, Horror
description: After reluctantly moving to the tiny village of Knobbly Bottom, Maggie is astonished when she encounters a flock of vampire sheep who are determined to take over the world. This hilarious chapter book, with a fast-paced plot and dynamic black-and-white illustrations, is the first in a fabulously funny series that is perfect for junior readers.

title: The Boy Who Fell from the Sky
author: Benjamin Dean
description: Zed’s dad is the First Hunter of Demons. But when Zed meets a Demon, he discovers thatthey​’renotas terrifying asthe mythssay. Exciting and full ofheart.

title: The Final Year
author: Matt Goodfellow, illustrated Joe Todd-Stanton
description: When he falls out with his best friend and then his little brother is rushed into hospital, Nate’s world is turned upside-down. This incredibly powerful novel, written entirely in free verse and accompanied by thoughtful illustrations, is an emotional read.

title: The Wonder Brothers
author: Frank Cottrell-Boyce, illustrated Steven Lenton
tags: Adventure, Around the world, Funny, Thriller
description: A funny, glitter-spangled, mystery thriller for anyone who likes a dose of danger with their magic.

title: Who Let the Words Out?
author: Joshua Seigal, illustrated Chris Piascik
description: A funny and engaging poetry collection, perfect for reading aloud and for sharing.

title: Can You Find My Eid Presents?
author: A. M. Dassu, illustrated Junissa Bianda
description: Hana can’t find the family’s Eid presents! She lookseverywhere– will she find them in time for Eid? A fun search-and-find story.

title: Aqua Boy
author: Ken Wilson-Max
description: Aaronis scared ofgoing under the water. But when he finds an octopus stranded on the beach, hemust be brave. A gentle story about facing fears, and about ocean conservation.

title: Does a Bear Wash Its Hair?
author: Moira Butterfield, illustrated Adam Ming
description: A fact-filled, rhyming picture bookabout self-care routines. Animals are just like you!

title: Flower Block
author: Lanisha Butterfield, illustrated Hoang Giang
description: Theo’s sunflower has grownrightthrough the tower block! A delightful celebration of nature and community.

title: Hamster Heroes
author: Peter Bently, illustrated John Bond
tags: Funny, Picture books, Poetry and rhyme
description: An action-packed and hilarious rhyming adventure which sees a team of hamster superheroes battle against a variety of rodent foes.

title: I Really Really Don’t Like Parties
author: Angie Morgan
description: Dora finds parties loud and overwhelming. But when she meets a similarly quiet child at a birthday, she realises they may not be sobad after all.

title: The Magic Callaloo
author: Trish Cooke, illustrated Sophie Bass
description: In a wonderful allegorical story highlighting a crucial part of Black history, superstar children’s author Trish Cooke tells a tale inspired by the real stories ofenslavedAfricans who made patterns in their cornrowed hair, using them as maps to escape their enslavers.

title: Wanna see A Llama?
author: Simon Philip, illustrated Ian Smith
description: Two children areout and aboutin a city, looking for llamas.One of the children issupposedlyallama expert, butwill the children find one?Funny andinteractive.

title: Wild Book Day
author: Karl Newson, illustrated James Brown
description: It’sWild Book Day, when all the pictures escape from the books. What fun they have!This is a book to make children leap about with excitement, but also to encourage a love of reading.Fun-filled book joy!

title: Astrid and the Space Cadets: Attack of the Snailiens!
author: Alex T Smith
tags: Adventure, Chapter books, Funny, Science fiction
description: Every night, six-year-old Astrid transforms into a Space Cadet, an intergalactic helper who zooms across the universe to solve problems and assist those in need. This fast-paced, funny chapter book is accompanied by magnificent black-and-white illustrations.

title: Beti and the Little Round House
author: Atinuke, illustrated Emily Hughes
description: Follow the adventures of Beti and her baby goat Naughty in this beautifully written and illustrated book as they explore the natural world which surrounds her little round house in the Welsh countryside.

title: Big Bad Wolf Investigates: Fairy Tales
author: Catherine Cawthorne, illustrated Sara Ogilvie
description: Could the Big Bad Wolfreallyblow down a straw house? A funny look at familiar fairy tales through the lens of STEM.

title: Croaky: Search for the Sasquatch
author: Matty Long
description: Croaky Hopper is a frogwho’skeen for adventure.Sohe’sthrilled to go on a Woggle Scouts camping trip. But will they find the mysterious Sasquatch?Colourful,funnyandfullof action.

title: Destiny Ink: Sleepover Surprise
author: Adeola Sokunbi
description: Destiny feels nervous about going to her first sleepover. When she meets a friendly monster, the two of themconquer their fears together and have loads of fun on the way!

title: Dino Dad
author: Andy Day, illustrated Steven Lenton
description: Ruby and her dad can change into dinosaurs! But can they find her little sister on the island ofDinotropolis?A sweet, yet madcap adventure full of brilliant illustrations.

title: Donut Feed the Squirrels
author: Mika Song
description: Two squirrels want donuts for breakfast – how will they get one? A delightful graphic novel with gentle humour for younger readers.

title: Dr Roopa’s Body Books: The Brilliant Brain
author: Dr Roopa Farooki, illustrated Viola Wang
description: A simple introduction to the way the brain works, with gorgeous bright illustrations. Ideal for young, curious children.

title: Habitats
author: Hannah Pang, illustrated Isobel Lundie
description: Explore the different layers of a variety of habitats with this beautiful non-fiction book, featuring interactive layered pages.

title: Holey Moley
author: Bethan Clarke, illustrated Anders Frang
tags: Funny, Picture books, Poetry and rhyme
description: Moles live in holes, right? This funny book plays with rhyme as Gus the Goat tries to guess where his friend Mavis Mole lives.

title: Murray and Bun: Murray the Viking
author: Adam Stower
description: Best friends Murray the cat and Bun the rabbitaremagically transported back to Viking times, where they become troll hunters. This hilarious comic caper, which is generously illustrated throughout, is the first instalment in an exciting new series for independent young readers.

title: Peggy Little-Legs
author: Pip Jones, illustrated Paula Bowles
description: A sausage dog finds out what they are best at in a fun, life-affirming dog adventure for new readers.

title: Poetry Comics
author: Grant Snider
description: Beautifully simple poemsare paired with comic-book style panel illustrations.Two characters across the course of the year as they express themselves through poetry.

title: Reggie Houser Has the Power
author: Helen Rutter
description: A touching, light-hearted book aboutfinding confidence and friendship.

title: Seek and Find: Ocean Animals
author: illustrated Diego Vaisberg
description: This interactive non-fiction bookuses aseekand find torch and flaps toexplore thedifferent animalspresent in ocean habitats.

title: Super Sausage to the Rescue
author: Rachel Morrisroe, illustrated Jenny Taylor
description: Dottie the flying dachshund must team up with her new owner Harry to rescue theSuperpetsfrom the evil clutches of a sparkly supervillain in thishilarious chapter book.

title: Taking Shelter
author: Guy Bass, illustrated Lee Cosgrove
description: Hugh is determined to clear his dog’s name when she’s accused of eating his homework. This hilarious chapter book is full of witty one-liners, daft puns and dynamic black-and-white illustrations.

title: Tangled Tales: Bites, Camera, Action! / Movies, Magic, Mayhem!
author: Jenny Moore, illustrated Sarah Horne
description: Two interlinked stories in one – flip the book to read the second one.WillDerek the vampireand Ruby the unusual fairy become film stars?

title: The Best You
author: Nima Patel, illustrated Cally Johnson-Isaacs
description: In this gentle and uplifting picture book, the common question​‘What do you want to be when you grow up?’ is turned on its head. Children are often asked to think aboutwhatjob they might like to do from an early age. And whilst there is nothing wrong with ambition, this question can feel difficult – after all, there is still so much to learn about the world and maybe you’d like to do many jobs!

title: The Last Zookeeper
author: Aaron Becker
description: Awordless picture bookfeaturing a robot protagonist and aflooded landscape. It is abeautifully illustrated modernretelling of the Noah’s arkstory.

title: The World’s First Rollercoaster and Other Amazing Inventions
author: Mike Barfield, illustrated Franziska Höllbacher
description: Find out the stories behind some of the world’s most important inventions in this funny, comic style, illustrated non-fiction book.

title: 100 Things to Know About Sport
author: by Usborne
description: Delve into the world of sports with this compilation of fascinating facts from around the world. Featuring engaging information,illustrationsand infographics, this isa great choicefor all sports lovers!

title: Angel of Grasmere
author: Tom Palmer
description: In the midst ofwar, amysterious figureisperforming acts of kindness in a Lake District village. Can Tarn find out who it is? An excellent addition to fiction about World War II.

title: Animal All-Stars
author: illustrated The Boy Fitz Hammond
description: Sports expert Clare Balding is here to commentate on a stupendous set of eight edge-of-your-seat sporting events featuring all manner of brilliantly fast, strong and agile animals.

title: Bird Boy
author: Catherine Bruton
description: Recently orphaned Will is sent to stay with an uncle hedoesn’tknow in a remote, mountainous valley.By caring for an injured osprey, heslowly comes to terms with his grief and learns to trust again.

title: Bobby Bains Plays a Blinder
author: Bali Rai, illustrated Daniel Duncan
description: Bobbywantshis nana-ji and Trevorto be friendsbecause they both love football. A heart-warming story of community and kindness – and football! Dyslexiafriendly,andappealing to all readers.

title: Dungeon Runners: Hero Trial
author: illustrated Joe Todd-Stanton
description: Presented in large, clear font and with black and white illustrations throughout, this funny, exciting, imaginative adventure story is a great introduction to fantasy fiction for newlyindependent readers.

title: Marnie Midnight and the Moon Mystery
author: Laura Ellen Anderson
description: When young moth Marnie Midnight enrols at Minibeast Academy, she and her new friends, Floyd the bee and Star the ant, embark on a perilous lunar adventure. The first in an exciting new series, this imaginative, bug-sized tale is richly illustrated and full of humour.

title: Monkey King and the World of Myths: The Monster and the Maze
author: Maple Lam
tags: Adventure, Funny, Graphic novels, Myths and legends
description: Sun Wukong, legendary monkey king and warrior, faces an ancient evil which threatens the world. Join him on awild and comical adventureas he battles the monsters of ancient Greece.

title: Movies Showing Nowhere
author: Yorick Goldewijk, illustrated Yvonne Lacet
description: When Cate visits Mrs Kano’s cinema, she is transported into a world beyond her wildest dreams. This wonderfully imaginative time-travel adventure beautifully explores the nature of grief, guilt and loneliness.

title: Nina Peanut is Amazing
author: Sarah Bowie
description: Nina Peanut is ahilarious, aspiringcontent creator. Whenone of her videosgoes viral,she must learnhow to cope with the challenges offame,friendshipand self-confidence.

title: Nora and the Map of Mayhem
author: Joseph Elliott, illustrated Nici Gregory
description: Can Nora and her great grandchildren find the treasure before her dastardly foe? A hoot of an adventure starring an energetic old lady, a determinedtoddlerand a wonky goose. Great fun.

title: Pirates of Darksea
author: Catherine Doyle
description: When Max answers the call to join Captain O’Malley’s pirate ship instead of his brother,who’sill,it’sthe start of a rip-roaring fantastical adventure.A page-turner that will have childrengripped and moved.

title: Rune: The Tale of a Thousand Faces
author: Carlos Sánchez
tags: Adventure, Fantasy, Funny, Graphic novels, Deafness
description: Chiriand Dai discover a hidden worldfilled with secrets and magic.Afterdiscovering their own hidden powers, the pair team up withabandofunlikelyheroes to take on thesinister Shadow King.

title: Skylar and the K‑Pop Headteacher
author: Luan Goldie
description: This funny, engaging, body-swap adventure explores fandom, friendship and empathy via an unmissable dance competition, viral videos and throwing away the school rule book.

title: The Clockwork Conspiracy
description: Isaac’s life is thrown into disarray when his dad mysteriously vanishes from the belfry of Big Ben. As they search for him, Isaac and his friend Hattie uncover asinister plot which threatens Time itself.Afast-paced mystery, whichwill have readers on the edge of their seats.

title: The Last Dragon
author: Polly Ho-Yen, illustrated Charis Loke
description: Anencounter with areal-lifedragon in Milton Keynes helps12-year-oldYara learn who she is.

title: Time Travellers: Adventure Calling
author: Sufiya Ahmed, illustrated Alessia Trunfio
description: A fascinatingtime-travel adventure exploringthepolitics and history of suffragettes.
